name: github
longDescription: Ask your chats about the repositories you work in: read issues and pull requests, open the files behind them, and comment back — all through a token you create in GitHub.

beforeYouConnect: GitHub asks you to paste a personal access token rather than sign you in, so make the token first.
A fine-grained token limited to the repositories you want Frink to work in is enough.
Tick Metadata, which every fine-grained token needs, plus Contents, Issues and Pull requests on those repositories.

actions.label: Search GitHub issues
actions.description: Finds issues across the repositories you can see.

actions.label: Read a GitHub issue
actions.description: Reads one issue by number, with its comments and labels.

actions.label: List GitHub pull requests
actions.description: Lists a repository's pull requests, open or closed.

actions.label: Read a file on GitHub
actions.description: Reads a file or folder from a branch of a repository.

actions.label: Comment on a GitHub issue
actions.description: Posts a comment on an issue or pull request.
